F03124

Ohmmeter

STA		STJ

F03814T03A1

INSPECTION OF COLD START INJECTOR TIME SWITCH

INSPECT RESISTANCE OF COLD START INJECTOR TIME SWITCH

Using an ohmmeter, measure the resistance between each terminal.

Resistance:
STA — STJ	25 — 45 Ω below 15°C (59°F)
		65 — 85 Ω above 30°C (86°F)
STA — Ground 25 — 85 Ω

If the resistance is not as specified, replace the switch.
